name: AMR spatial-resolution convergence
purpose: Establish that spatial discretization error is below the declared M1 science tolerances for a stationary physical problem.
production_capability: Input-driven production AMR, frozen-epoch SPICE environment, normal particle mover, sources, surface interactions, and science samplers.
configuration: Approved memory-budget sphere template m1_memory200.in: 480, 240, 120, 60 km; legacy FULL m1_sphere.in retains 40, 20, 10, 5 km when explicitly selected. Other CUSTOM/QUICK inputs rejected. Frozen environment, sample length 500 particle steps, maximum 5000 particle steps per resolution, particle restart writes disabled, unchanged seeds/MPI/OpenMP layout and accuracy criteria.
inputs: four derived and archived resolution receipts
independent_reference: Successive-resolution convergence, stationary-block statistics, and the invariant that repeated production steps retain identical external SPICE/frame state.
units: metres, seconds, number density per cubic metre, return flux per square metre per second, column density per square metre, Rayleigh
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO; MOON_ME_DE421 body controls; all external environment quantities frozen at the receipt UTC converted to TDB ET.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Production random seed 731993; one explicitly recorded positive MPI rank count and OpenMP=1 at every resolution; 500 particle steps per completed sample; hard limit of 5000 particle steps per resolution; particle restart writes disabled; adaptive non-overlapping batch means with lag-one significance bound 1.96/sqrt(N); four independent means for three equilibrium changes followed by five disjoint science means.
procedure: Derive and archive 480/240/120/60 km (or explicitly selected legacy 40/20/10/5 km) receipts by scaling the surface, near-surface, angular, and polar targets while keeping physical extents and far/outer targets fixed; verify the frozen production environment; run every resolution for no more than 5000 particle steps while monitoring process-tree and block resource use; MPI-reduce production-owned samples every 500 steps; after every completed stage render explicitly unqualified raw CSV/PNG/EPS/JSON diagnostics; apply the unchanged independence, equilibrium, CI, and successive-grid criteria. When the cap is reached first, preserve raw diagnostics, mark the level and campaign FAIL, run the remaining requested levels, and do not create accepted cross-grid metrics from unqualified means.
acceptance_criteria: External-state drift exactly zero; equilibration <=2% for three consecutive blocks; at least five independent science blocks; 95% CI half-width <=1.67% integrated and <=3.33% pointwise; successive-resolution change <5% integrated and <10% pointwise.
expected_pass_result: The finest retained M1 mesh has quantified numerical and statistical error below every declared tolerance.
expected_failure_modes: 5000-step limit reached before all independence, equilibrium, and precision gates
required_data: campaign-generated outputs only; no observational data
data_hashes: SPICE, input, executable, and every derived receipt/output hash are required in run manifests.
artifacts: four-level convergence table only after all four levels qualify
status_semantics: PASS requires the complete four-resolution campaign and every unchanged statistical/spatial gate before the cap. FAIL includes reaching 5000 particle steps before qualification; all four bounded levels and explicitly unqualified stage plots are retained, but no accepted cross-grid comparison is made from raw means. Build/runtime/parser/resource exhaustion, interruption, enabled restart writes, missing diagnostic artifacts, or corrupt artifacts are ERROR. SKIPPED is reserved for a genuinely unavailable prerequisite or production capability.
